question: What is the ranking of India in the World Happiness Report 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**118th**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• In the **World Happiness Report 2025**, India has been ranked **118th** among 143 countries surveyed globally.

• India showed an improvement of **8 positions** compared to the previous year, where it was ranked **126th** in the **2024** report.

• The report is an annual publication of the **United Nations Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)** and is released to mark the **International Day of Happiness** on **March 20th**.

• The rankings are determined based on self-reported life evaluations from the **Gallup World Poll**, averaged over a three-year period (2022-2024 for the 2025 report).

• The report considers six primary factors to explain the variation in happiness levels: **GDP per capita**, **social support**, **healthy life expectancy**, **freedom to make life choices**, **generosity**, and **perception of corruption**.

**Additional Information__**

• **Finland** has secured the **1st rank** for the **8th consecutive year**, maintaining its status as the happiest country in the world.

• The top five happiest nations in the 2025 list include **Finland**, **Denmark**, **Iceland**, **Sweden**, and **Israel**.

• **Afghanistan** continues to be ranked at the bottom of the index (**143rd**), followed by **Lebanon** and **Lesotho**.

• The 2025 report also focused on the **well-being of different age groups**, noting that happiness levels among the **youth** have seen a decline in several Western nations.

• Among India's neighbors, countries like **Nepal**, **China**, and **Bhutan** typically rank higher than India in this index.
